notes: The supplied whole image is landscape, 2371 by 1691 pixels. Half a is 1245 by 1691; half b is 1246 by 1691. All report boxes use whole-image coordinates. Whole, a and b were each viewed exactly once, then each of eleven tight crops once.

This face consists of category-like F/s/t/sigma/mu notation, isolated letters, products of triangles and numerous sketched cell figures. There is no continuous handwritten prose, title, date, manuscript folio, or explicit author question/doubt mark. This is an observation, not a mathematical identification or proof.

The only genuinely readable type on this face is the sideways address, the following MATHEMATIQUES with a doubtful tiny terminal mark, and the separated 5. No additional typed word or line is recoverable from the pale background. The other faint remnants look reversed or like large handwritten show-through; H's editorial assertion of typescript show-through has not been used to reconstruct text.

The separate lower-left 2 is recorded as an archive sheet number in a TeX comment, following the authorized packet convention. The typed 5 is retained as part of the address material, not promoted to a manuscript folio.
